about: What friends in Pumpkin Hollow (the Halloween island) say. First matching entry wins; the last has no condition.

say: HI {name}! I'M {@cat-patch}. DO YOU LIKE MY PUMPKIN HAT?
I LOOK AFTER THE PUMPKIN PATCH. SOME OF THESE PUMPKINS ARE BIGGER THAN ME!
HEE HEE! I'M {@cat-hazel}, AND I'M PRACTISING BROOM TRICKS.
DON'T TELL ANYONE, {name}... I CAN'T QUITE FLY YET! THE CAULDRON ONLY MAKES PUMPKIN SOUP.
HI {name}! I'M {@cat-flit}. I'M NOT A REAL BAT, BUT I LOVE MY WINGS.
THE HAUNTED HOUSE ISN'T SCARY AT ALL. THE GHOSTS INSIDE JUST WANT SOMEONE TO PLAY WITH!
AT NIGHT THE MOON SITS RIGHT IN THE MIDDLE OF THIS POND. THE OWL ON THE LITTLE ISLAND WATCHES IT WITH ME.
BOO! HEE HEE, DID I SURPRISE YOU? I'M {@ghost-boo}!
WELCOME TO PUMPKIN HOLLOW, {name}! WALK THROUGH THE BIG ARCH AND SAY HELLO TO EVERYONE.
OOOH, HELLO {name}. I'M {@ghost-misty}. I LOOK AFTER THE GRAVEYARD.
IT'S VERY QUIET HERE. THE CROWS AND I PLAY HIDE AND SEEK BEHIND THE STONES.
HEE HEE HEE! I'M {@ghost-giggles}! I LIVE IN THE HAUNTED HOUSE.
I'M NOT VERY GOOD AT SCARING. I JUST START GIGGLING! HEE HEE!
